variant.title: Composite Sudoku
variant.description: Cells marked with C may contain only composite digits: 4, 6, 8 or 9.
rule.composite: Cells marked with C may contain only composite digits: 4, 6, 8 or 9.
rule_guide.title: Composite Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Cells marked with C may contain only composite digits.
rule_guide.item_2: The composite digits in this rule are 4, 6, 8 and 9. The digit 1 is neither prime nor composite.
rule_guide.item_3: Unmarked cells have no extra Composite rule restriction and follow normal Sudoku rules.
